summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper and related changes. Added EndpointResolverBuiltins enum in botocore/regions.py; added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults and a private _resolve_sdk_endpoint helper on ClientArgsCreator in botocore/args.py; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config; added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (27 tests) in tests/unit/test_args.py. All 59 tests in tests/unit/test_args.py pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures, identical before and after my changes (pre-existing). Not verified: black and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so lint/format was checked only by hand (one pre-existing over-79 line at botocore/args.py:315). Choices made: absent SDK::Endpoint is stored as None under its key rather than omitted; bridge lookups use the private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint methods. Nothing committed.
